llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed guide for checking a paid external crypto risk signal and optional attestations before trading; no hidden code or automatic wallet action was found.

dimensions.detail: The purpose and capabilities fit together: it provides curl-based calls to GBLIN risk, attestation, and verification endpoints, plus optional treasury/index information. It is finance-related and may influence trading or capital movement, but the paid endpoints and optional investment use are disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to querying documented endpoints, handling x402 payment responses with existing wallet tooling, verifying attestations, and optionally inspecting or preparing treasury actions. It explicitly warns not to treat the signal as financial advice and not to put private keys in environment variables.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single markdown skill requiring curl. It has no executable scripts or install hooks; the only package execution mentioned is an optional, disclosed npx command for the related MCP server.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access to GBLIN domains, x402 payment tooling, and a wallet with USDC on Base are proportionate to the stated on-chain risk-checking purpose, but users should understand that paid requests and blockchain transactions may have financial consequences.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, credential harvesting, or automatic key handling is present. Attestations may be attached to logs only as a user-directed proof-of-diligence workflow.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want your agent to consult GBLIN's external crypto risk service. Review the micro-payment costs, use a wallet tool you trust, keep private keys out of this skill's environment, and require explicit approval before signing any paid request or investment calldata.
